I'm Janitha, an IT support professional with an honours degree in IT, a CCNA certification and hands-on experience in onsite and remote technical support for Windows and macOS environments.

I have professional experience in L1/L2 IT support across service desk, onsite and remote environments. I troubleshoot hardware, software, operating systems, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Active Directory, user onboarding and access management, network connectivity and workstation problems, and I record every incident clearly in ticketing systems like Jira Service Management.

I'm also building cloud skills, with AWS Fundamentals in progress. People know me as reliable and patient, and I focus on getting users working again with as little disruption as possible.
